repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T04:15Z · On this card's fork (how the view settings panel looks on a list view shipped inside a read-only package), the maintainer chose **A, a read-only panel**, at 2026-11-21T04:14:01Z, in the project chat. An earlier reply at 2026-11-21T04:08:18Z proposed a third way and was withdrawn at 2026-11-21T04:09:29Z. The maintainer then checked the code: the toolbar's sort, filter, column width, order and visibility changes are saved to the person's own preferences, but the admin "configure view" panel's save writes into the view itself, so on a read-only package view the server refuses it.

Recorded meaning:
- On a package-shipped read-only view, the "configure view" panel opens and shows the configuration, but nothing in it can be saved: no save, and its controls do not edit the view.
- In Manage Views, pin, set as default and delete are not offered on such views.
- The toolbar's own personal changes (sort, filter, columns) are untouched; they keep saving to the person's preferences.
- When the writable verdict can't be read, today's behaviour stays (offered; the server refuses), as #35933 does.
- A custom shared view and a personal view are unchanged.

Dispatched to area b1-DB. The PR carries `Fixes #35974`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim amendment to comment 7057506464 · 2026-11-21T05:32Z · The maintainer's ruling 7057139393 (A) has the settings panel open read-only on a view a read-only package ships. The console's only way into that panel is Manage views' "Edit view config", and `ManageViewsDialog` (`@object-ui/plugin-view`, published) drops that entry for every read-only row. Built as claimed, the panel could not be opened on these views, which is the option the maintainer declined. Seat call: `ViewTabItem` gains one optional row flag that keeps the config entry on a read-only row (labelled as viewing, not editing). The app-shell sets it only on rows a read-only package ships; without the flag, every existing caller and system view behaves as today. Two lines change:
File surface: adds `ui/packages/plugin-view` (`ManageViewsDialog.tsx`, the `ViewTabItem` type, a test) and a `@object-ui/plugin-view` patch changeset, beside the app-shell files already claimed.
Clause-②: yes (widening: one new optional member on the published `ViewTabItem`; nothing removed). The seat runs the declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Everything else in the claim stands.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Ruling record · 2026-11-21T06:30Z · amends ruling 7057139393. The maintainer (os-sales) answered the seat's decision card at 2026-11-21T06:29Z, choosing 「只隐藏删除，其余保留」.

Why it came back: the card's premise that the server refuses every Manage views action on a view a read-only package ships was wrong. Since #33173 (merged 2026-11-14T00:00Z), pin, set default and rename are written into the package's customization pair (`<package>.custom`), and the card thread measured pin and set default at 200 with read-back. Only the settings panel's save and delete are refused (403).

The rule now, on such a view:
- The settings panel opens read-only and cannot save (unchanged from 7057139393), reachable from Manage views as "view config".
- Manage views hides only Delete. Pin, set default and rename stay offered; they are stored in the customization package and every user of the view sees them.
- The Rename hiding that #35975 added for these views is lifted in this card's PR, after one measured rename through the customization pair.
- Toolbar personal state is unaffected; fail-open stays.

Follow-up filed by the seat: restoring the factory view from the list page after such a customization.
